levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Only one storage option is actually tested, or both are set up but not really tried.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Both storage options are tested by actually retrieving and putting away the same items.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner ties their choice to a specific feature of the items themselves, such as how they're used, how many there are, or how they look.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The chosen option is stated without a specific reason, such as 'I like it better.'

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: A specific reason is given, connected to speed, visibility, or fit.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner explains why a storage spot has to match actual use, not just appearance.

lookFors: The item group is real and actually lacked a working storage spot before this lesson.
Both storage options were physically set up and used, not just imagined.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
